title: Task Outcome settlement consistency and recovery

baseline.rendererEvidence: S2C-D rerun of real Electron 44.4.5 Renderer/Main/Runner verification

atomicity.durableEventIdentity: stable per Run; duplicate content is idempotent and conflicting content is rejected
atomicity.executionLog: atomic single-file replace; not atomic with other stores
atomicity.recoveryRule: settle a proposed reply only after exact matching proposal is found in the trusted Session transcript
atomicity.missingExecutionLog: public Task Outcome safely degrades to unknown; no tool replay or evidence reconstruction

faultMatrix.expected: conservative unknown; no final reply settlement or run completion
faultMatrix.evidence: durable proposal, Outcome event, reply event, completion event and Effect counts

faultMatrix.expected: reply and Run can reconcile from exact persisted transcript; public outcome unknown without audit log
faultMatrix.evidence: durable outcome and event identities, missing ExecutionLog, public replay value

faultMatrix.expected: matching reply is settled once and Run completes
faultMatrix.evidence: ExecutionLog Task Outcome, transcript proposal, durable events and Effect counts
reply registry, final_reply_settled and run_completed event counts
stable Run ID and single Outcome/reply/completion identities

faultMatrix.expected: second recovery leaves one logical settlement of each type
faultMatrix.evidence: real recovery child process kill and a second recovery pass

fileEvidence.meaning: exact bytes observed at checkedAt, not a claim about current file contents or existence
fileEvidence.rendererCopy: historical check is not automatically repeated after file changes
covered: later successful same-Run write invalidates old check
external file modification after check and before Outcome event
history replay after external modification and deletion
